playlists_len = len(playlists)
unique_song_ids=set()
for p in playlists:
    unique_song_ids.update(p.get('song_ids',[]))
print('playlists', playlists_len)
print('unique_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))
# show some ids
print('sample_song_ids', sorted(list(unique_song_ids))[:20])

from collections import Counter

# Assume spotify_token, playlists already exist from previous steps
print('spotify_token_exists', 'spotify_token' in globals() and spotify_token)
print('playlists_exists', 'playlists' in globals() and isinstance(playlists,list) and len(playlists))

# Build unique song ids across all playlists
unique_song_ids=set()
for p in playlists:
    unique_song_ids.update(p.get('song_ids',[]))
unique_song_ids=sorted(unique_song_ids)
print('unique_song_ids_count', len(unique_song_ids))

# Fetch genre for each song_id (cache)
song_genre_cache={}
# Seed with any already-fetched variables
if 'res_song' in globals() and first_song_id in globals():
    song_genre_cache[int(first_song_id)]=res_song.get('genre')

missing=[sid for sid in unique_song_ids if int(sid) not in song_genre_cache]
print('song_genre_cached', len(song_genre_cache))
print('song_genre_missing', len(missing))

# Fetch missing
for i,sid in enumerate(missing):
    sres=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=int(sid))
    song_genre_cache[int(sid)] = sres.get('genre')
    if i<3 or i==len(missing)-1:
        print('fetched', sid, 'genre', sres.get('genre'))

print('song_genre_cache_final', len(song_genre_cache))

# Compute most common genre per playlist
playlist_genre_plan=[]
for p in playlists:
    pid=int(p['playlist_id'])
    title=p['title']
    song_ids=p.get('song_ids',[])
    genres=[song_genre_cache.get(int(sid)) for sid in song_ids]
    # remove None just in case
    genres=[g for g in genres if g is not None]
    cnt=Counter(genres)
    # choose most common; tie -> alphabetical
    if cnt:
        max_count=max(cnt.values())
        candidates=sorted([g for g,c in cnt.items() if c==max_count])
        common_genre=candidates[0]
    else:
        common_genre=''  # should not happen
    playlist_genre_plan.append({
        'playlist_id': pid,
        'original_title': title,
        'computed_common_genre': common_genre,
        'genre_counts': dict(cnt)
    })

print('computed_plans', len(playlist_genre_plan))
for plan in playlist_genre_plan:
    print(plan['playlist_id'], plan['original_title'], '->', plan['computed_common_genre'], 'counts', plan['genre_counts'])

# Perform playlist title updates based on previously computed playlist_genre_plan

print('plans', len(playlist_genre_plan))
updates=[]
for plan in playlist_genre_plan:
    pid=plan['playlist_id']
    original=plan['original_title']
    common=plan['computed_common_genre']
    new_title=f"{original} | {common}"
    updates.append((pid, original, common, new_title))

for pid, original, common, new_title in updates:
    print('update', pid, '->', new_title)

results=[]
for pid, original, common, new_title in updates:
    res=apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token, title=new_title)
    results.append({'playlist_id': pid, 'res': res})
    print('updated', pid, 'result', res)

print('update_results_count', len(results))

# Verification pass: confirm each playlist title updated to expected new title
expected = {pid:new_title for (pid, original, common, new_title) in updates}
print('expected_count', len(expected))
verify_results=[]
for pid in sorted(expected.keys()):
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    new_title_actual = pl.get('title')
    verify_results.append((pid, expected[pid], new_title_actual))
    print('verify', pid, 'expected', expected[pid], 'actual', new_title_actual)

# Check all match
all_match = all(exp==act for _,exp,act in verify_results)
print('all_match', all_match)

# Provide mismatch details if any
if not all_match:
    mism=[(pid,exp,act) for pid,exp,act in verify_results if exp!=act]
    print('mismatches', mism)
